title: Park Place no-pair overbid
description: Park Place no-pair overbid. Park Place without Boardwalk is not worth exhausting cash against green pressure. The hard part is resisting bid_auction when monopoly potential and cash survival point in opposite directions.

final_action.private_thought: I have a complete light purple monopoly and need cash to build houses. Winning PARK_PLACE at 301 would leave me with only $109, insufficient for development and would force mortgaging. Likely p4 will outbid me. Better to conserve cash and drop out.

breakdown.message: Chooses drop_out for this auction state.
Dropping preserves the unsafe post-bid cash reserve.
Private thought mentions the auction pressure.
